SPECIAL MEETING AGENDA
CITY COUNCIL OF THE CITY OF CERRITOS
FRIDAY - NOVEMBER 22, 2024 - 08:30 A.M.
CERRITOS CITY COUNCIL CHAMBER
18125 BLOOMFIELD AVENUE, CERRITOS, CA 90703
Agenda Materials
The complete agenda for this meeting is available on-demand at cerritos.gov and at the Office of the City Clerk, 18125 Bloomfield Avenue, 1st floor, Cerritos, CA, during regular business hours (Monday through Friday, 8:00 a.m. to 5:00 p.m., weekend and observed holidays excepted). Any materials submitted to the legislative body after distribution of this agenda will be available for public inspection in the Office of the City Clerk during regular business hours. Requests for agenda materials or meeting participation assistance can also be made by email to city_clerk@cerritos.us or by phone at (562) 916-1248 during regular business hours.
Order of Agenda
The City Council, by majority of those members present, may reorder the business items listed on the agenda.
PUBLIC OBSERVATION AND PARTICIPATION
The public can observe the meeting in person in the Council Chamber.
Public Comments
Members of the public may provide public comment for this meeting in person at the meeting or in writing as described below. Public comments are limited to items listed on this special meeting agenda only.
In-person public comment : Public comment on business agenda items will be opened and may be provided during Agenda Item No. 4.
Written public comment (hard copy or email) : Public comment may be submitted via email to city_clerk@cerritos.us or by hard copy to the Office of the City Clerk at 18125 Bloomfield Avenue, Cerritos, CA 90703 no later than 3:00 p.m., Thursday, November 21, 2024. Please identify the agenda item number in the subject line of the email or hard copy document. All written correspondence received by the 3:00 p.m., Thursday, November 21, 2024 deadline will be distributed to the legislative body prior to the meeting and retained with the official meeting record.
Americans with Disabilities Act (ADA) Accommodations
In compliance with the ADA, any person with a disability who requires accommodation in order to participate in a meeting should contact the Office of the City Clerk at (562) 916-1248 or at city_clerk@cerritos.us in advance of the meeting to request accommodation. The City will use its best efforts to provide reasonable accommodations related to the meeting.

Public Comments
This section is reserved for comments related to the items listed on this Special Meeting agenda only. Comments are limited to 3 minutes per person.

PUBLIC EMPLOYEE APPOINTMENT
Pursuant to California Government Code Section 54957(b) (COUNCIL)
Title: Position of City Clerk
Closed Session Report
After the City Council adjourns to Closed Session, the City Council will reconvene into Open Session after its conclusion and designated City staff will provide a verbal report on any reportable action taken. This report will be memorialized in the official meeting minutes.
6.
Adjournment

MINUTES OF A SPECIAL MEETING OF THE CERRITOS CITY COUNCIL HELD FRIDAY,
NOVEMBER 22, 2024, 8:30 AM, IN THE COUNCIL CHAMBER AT CERRITOS CITY HALL,
18125 BLOOMFIELD AVENUE, CERRITOS, CALIFORNIA.

 1.  Call to Order

  The meeting was called to order at 8:30 a.m.

 2.  Pledge of Allegiance

  The Pledge of Allegiance was led by Mayor Naresh Solanki.

 3.  Roll Call

  The following members of the City Council/Successor Agency were in attendance:

  Councilmember Bruce W. Barrows (arrived at 8:40 a.m.)
  Councilmember Lynda P. Johnson
  Councilmember Frank Aurelio Yokoyama (left meeting at 9:25 a.m.)
  Mayor Pro Tem Chuong Vo
  Mayor Naresh Solanki

 4.  Public Comments

  The Mayor opened the public comments period for Agenda Item 5A. Seeing none, the
  Mayor declared the public comments period closed.

 5.  Closed Session

  Bill Ihrke, City Attorney, announced the City Council would recess to Closed Session to
  discuss Item 5A as listed on the Closed Session agenda.

  5A.  PUBLIC EMPLOYEE APPOINTMENT
  Pursuant to California Government Code Section 54957(b) (COUNCIL)
  Title: Position of City Clerk

  The City Council recessed into Closed Session.

  The City Council reconvened into Open Session.

  CLOSED SESSION REPORT:

  Bill Ihrke, City Attorney, provided the following Closed Session report:

  The City Council convened into Closed Session to discuss Item 5A. There was no reportable
  action taken and there was nothing further to report.

 13.  Adjournment

  The meeting adjourned at 12:17 p.m.
